text:
Maria C: Quick status check — kernel KV warmup + continuous batching work. Friday demo is on the calendar; want a one-liner for blockers, owners, and any infra deps.

Ben R: PR 4321 is up for the warmup handshake (warming + prefetch flow). tests pass locally, CI flaky on one GPU test. Requesting CR from @Sophia L. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 :eyes:

Sophia L: I can review after stand. Quick note on canary numbers: we saw ~12% p50 improvement on long-tail models when warmup enabled but p99 jumped ~6% on 4096 seq in the first 30m of canary. Need to confirm if that's cache-priming related or a scheduling artifact.

Eli K: FYI there's an eng-infra kernel driver rollout (kernel-ops/driver-2.3) that changes how GPU kernel selection reports occupancy. That lands tomorrow morning in us-west-2 and the canary will pick it up. This could explain the p99 wobble.

Jon I: Confirmed — infra rollout is staged and does not change API surface, just telemetry hooks. No blocking migrations, but will temporarily bump kernel probe time during rollout window (approx 15m).

Maria C: OK: sounds like two potential confounders: (1) PR 4321 behavior, (2) infra rollout probes. Action items I propose: 
- Ben: rebase + add a short regression test that simulates primed KV vs cold start (owner: @Ben R)
- Sophia: CR + look at p99 spike correlation with kernel probes (owner: @Sophia L)
- Jon/Eli: note rollout window and add a flag to suppress probe logs for canary (owner: @Jon I)
- Alex: propose fallback policy change if p99 > 5% during canary (owner: @Alex P)
Please ack and ETA.

Ben R: ack. I can add test + small perf harness by EOD PST. Will include a reproducer script: 
```
# reproducer pseudo
python perf_harness.py --model long-tail --seq 4096 --warmup 1 --iters 200
```

Sophia L: ack. Will review PR today and run local canary with Ben's reproducer after his test lands. ETA lunchtime PST.

Jon I: ack. I'll add probe-suppress flag and coordinate with infra rollout schedule. Should be able to gate probe changes behind env var so canary unaffected. ETA morning rollout prep (8:30am PT).

Alex P: I'll prepare a quick fallback config: if p99 increases >5% for 10m, roll traffic to non-warmup variant and notify oncall. Config snippet: 
```
fallback:
  metric: p99_latency
  window: 600s
  threshold: 1.05
  action: switch_variant(non-warmup)
```

Maria C: Perfect. Two small asks: (1) Ben — ping me when CI stabilizes so we can schedule a canary window, (2) Sophia — if you see the p99 correlating with probe events, file a short note in the canary ticket so we can annotate graphs. I'll consolidate actions into a single ticket and tag owners.

Ben R: pinging here when CI green. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

devops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-05-12 15:00 UTC (canary id: canary-78). Notifying owners: Maria C, Ben R, Sophia L, Jon I.

Maria C: closing loop — I created infra ticket RT-7890 and linked PR 4321 + canary. I'll send a short status to the demo stakeholders after we validate the warmup won't regress p99. If anyone hits blockers, @here call it out in this thread.

Alex P: small note — if we need to roll back quickly, add an immediate kill switch to the routing table (we have a header-based route that can be flipped). I'll attach the playbook to RT-7890.

Eli K: thanks — putting the rollout window on my calendar to watch telemetry.

Sophia L: will post review comments shortly.

Jon I: will coordinate probe flag PR and land it behind env var.

Maria C: thanks team — short sync later if needed. :rocket:
